# MULTICLASS CLASSIFICATION
```{r}
# load data
bills <- read.csv("bill_sums.csv")

# rename columns
bills <- bills %>% rename('bill_id' = 'Legislation.Number',
         'status' = 'Latest.Tracker.Stage',
         'summary' = 'Latest.Summary')

# isolate desired columns
bills <- subset(bills, select = c(bill_id, status, summary))

# drop bills that have no summary
bills <- bills %>% filter(nchar(summary) > 1)

# clean html text
clean_html_text <- function(text) {
  gsub("<.*?>", "", text)
}
bills$summary <- clean_html_text(bills$summary)
bills_binary <- bills # save for binary classification
bills
```
```{r}
# tokenize: get vector of words in bill text
tokenize <- function(text) {
  str_split(text, " ")[[1]]
}
all_tokens <- unlist(lapply(bills$summary, tokenize))

# get vocab
vocab <- unique(all_tokens)

# string to ints: map words to unique IDs
stoi <- setNames(seq_along(vocab), vocab) 
vocab <- vocab[vocab != ""] # remove empties
stoi[["<unk>"]] <- length(stoi) + 1 # create token for words not in vocab
stoi[["<pad>"]] <- length(stoi) + 1 # make sequences a fixed length
vocab_size <- length(stoi)

# convert text to int sequences
text_to_int <- function(text, max_len = 200) { # returns vector of ints that represent IDs for each word in vocab
  # tokenize
  tokens <- tokenize(text)

  # replace each word with its integer ID
  ids <- match(tokens, names(stoi))

  # replace NAs with <unk> token ID
  ids[is.na(ids)] <- stoi[["<unk>"]]

  # pad / truncate to make sequences a fixed length
  if (length(ids) < max_len) {
    ids <- c(ids, rep(stoi[["<pad>"]], max_len - length(ids)))
  } else {
    ids <- ids[1:max_len]
  }
  ids
}

# build input data. each row is a bill text, each col represents token positions within the vector
X <- torch_tensor(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(bills$summary, text_to_int, max_len = 200)),
  dtype = torch_long()
)

# label encoding
labels_words <- unique(bills$status)
labels <- as.integer(as.factor(bills$status)) 
num_classes <- length(unique(labels))
bills$label <- labels

# build label data
y <- torch_tensor(bills$label, dtype = torch_long())
X
```

```{r}
# train test split 
num_rows <- nrow(bills)
idx <- sample(1:num_rows)

train_end <- floor(0.70 * num_rows)
val_end   <- floor(0.85 * num_rows)

train_idx <- idx[1:train_end] # 70% of dataset
val_idx   <- idx[(train_end+1):val_end] # 15% of dataset
test_idx  <- idx[(val_end+1):num_rows] # 15% of dataset

# create data splits
x_train <- X[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]
x_val <- X[val_idx, ]
y_val <- y[val_idx]
x_test <- X[test_idx, ]
y_test <- y[test_idx]

cat("training samples:", length(train_idx), "\n")
cat("testing samples:", length(test_idx), "\n")
cat("validation samples:", length(val_idx))

```

```{r}
# model architecture
multiclass_cnn <- nn_module(
  initialize = function(num_classes) {
    
    embedding_dim <- 100
    num_filters <- 100
    
    self$embedding <- nn_embedding( # converts word IDs to semantic meanings through backprop in training. allows model to learn relationships between words
      num_embeddings = vocab_size,
      embedding_dim = embedding_dim,
      padding_idx = stoi[["<pad>"]]
    )
     
    self$conv1 <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = 2
    )
    
    self$conv2 <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = 3
    )
    
    self$conv3 <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = 5
    )
    
    self$dropout <- nn_dropout(p = 0.3) 
    
    self$fc <- nn_linear( # creates scores of how strongly model thinks each class is correct
      in_features = num_filters * 3, 
      out_features = num_classes   
    ) # loss function applies softmax output function internally during training loop
  },
  
  forward = function(x) {
    x <- self$embedding(x) # (batch, 100, MAX_LEN)
    x <- x$permute(c(1, 3, 2))
    
    # 'parallel' conv -> ReLU -> max pool -> squeeze for the same input but with different gram sizes
    x1 <- self$conv1(x) # 2 gram conv
    x1 <- torch_relu(x1)
    x1 <- nnf_max_pool1d(x1, kernel_size = x1$size(3))
    x1 <- x1$squeeze(3) 
    
    x2 <- self$conv2(x) # 3 gram conv
    x2 <- torch_relu(x2)
    x2 <- nnf_max_pool1d(x2, kernel_size = x2$size(3))
    x2 <- x2$squeeze(3)
    
    x3 <- self$conv3(x) # 5 gram conv
    x3 <- torch_relu(x3)
    x3 <- nnf_max_pool1d(x3, kernel_size = x3$size(3))
    x3 <- x3$squeeze(3)
    
    # combine feat vectors (batch × 300)
    x <- torch_cat(list(x1, x2, x3), dim = 2)

    x <- self$dropout(x) # dropout regularization
    
    x <- torch_flatten(x, start_dim = 2) 
    
    logits <- self$fc(x) # logits are relative scores of classes
    return(logits)   
  }
)

# initialize
model <- multiclass_cnn(num_classes)

# weight each class
class_counts <- table(bills$label) 
class_weights <- 1 / as.numeric(class_counts)
loss_fn <- nn_cross_entropy_loss(weight = torch_tensor(class_weights, dtype = torch_float()))

# ADAM optimization
optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.001)

class_counts <- table(bills$status)
cat("Class distribution:")
print(class_counts)
```

```{r}
# training setup
epochs <- 75
batch_size <- 32
n <- length(y_train)

# train model
for (epoch in seq_len(epochs)) {
  model$train()
  epoch_loss <- 0
  idx <- sample(1:length(y_train))  # shuffle
  
  for (i in seq(1, length(idx), by = batch_size)) {
    # batch
    start <- i
    end <- min(i + batch_size - 1, n)
    batch_indices <- torch_tensor(idx[start:end], dtype = torch_long())
    batch_inputs <- x_train$index_select(1, batch_indices)
    batch_labels <- y_train$index_select(1, batch_indices)
    
    # forward pass
    preds <- model(batch_inputs)
    loss <- loss_fn(preds, batch_labels)
    
    # backpropagation
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()
    
    epoch_loss <- epoch_loss + loss$item()
  }
  
  # validation!
  model$eval()
  with_no_grad({ # temporarily disable gradient calculation to speed up model since there's no weight update in validation anyway
    val_logits <- model(x_val)
    val_preds <- torch_argmax(val_logits, dim = 2)
    val_acc <- mean(as_array(val_preds) == as_array(y_val))
  })
  
  # compare model performance and save best model
  if (val_acc > best_val_acc) {
    best_val_acc <- val_acc
    torch_save(model, "multiclass_model.pt")
  }
  
  val_loss <- loss_fn(val_logits, y_val)$item()
  
  if (epoch %% 10 == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("epoch %d, train loss: %.4f\n", epoch, epoch_loss))
    cat(sprintf("epoch %d, validation loss: %.4f\n", epoch, val_loss))
    cat("\n")
    }
}

# dimensions
dim(batch_inputs)
batch_inputs$shape
class(model) 
model

```
```{r}
# evaluate
model$eval()

# get logits
logits <- model(x_test)

# convert logits to predicted class index
preds <- torch_argmax(logits, dim = 2)$to(dtype = torch_int())

# convert to vectors
true <- as_array(y_test)
pred <- as_array(preds)

# each class accuracy
per_class_acc <- list()

for (k in 1:num_classes) {
  idx <- which(true == k)

  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    per_class_acc[k] <- mean(pred[idx] == true[idx])
  } else {
    per_class_acc[k] <- NA
  }
}

cat("Class Accuracy:\n")
for (i in 1:num_classes){
  cat(sprintf("%s: %s\n", labels_words[i], per_class_acc[i]))
}

# overall accuracy
overall_accuracy <- mean(true == pred)
cat("\nOverall Accuracy:", overall_accuracy, "\n")

# confusion matrix
cat("\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
cm_multi <- table(True = true, Predicted = pred)
print(cm_multi)
```
```{r}
# heatmap
cm_multi_df <- melt(cm_multi)
label_order <- c("Introduced", "Passed Senate", "Passed House", 
                  "Failed Senate", "Failed House", "Resolving Differences", 
                  "To President", "Vetoed by President", 
                  "Failed to pass over veto", "Became Law")

# map numerical labels to categorical
label_mapping <- data.frame(
  number = 1:num_classes,
  word = sort(unique(bills$status))  # sort to match
)
cm_multi_df$Predicted <- label_mapping$word[match(cm_multi_df$Predicted, label_mapping$number)]
cm_multi_df$True <- label_mapping$word[match(cm_multi_df$True, label_mapping$number)]

# preserve order
cm_multi_df$Predicted <- factor(cm_multi_df$Predicted, levels = label_order)
cm_multi_df$True <- factor(cm_multi_df$True, levels = label_order)

# plot heatmap
ggplot(cm_multi_df, aes(x = Predicted, y = True, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#1f77b4", name = "Count") +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix - Multi Classification",
       x = "Predicted",
       y = "True") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
```

# BINARY CLASSIFICATION

```{r}
# reclassify all bills other than 'became law' for binary classification 
bills_binary$label <- as.integer(bills$status == "Became Law")
bills_binary <- subset(bills_binary, select=c(bill_id, label, summary))

# build input data
X <- torch_tensor(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(bills_binary$summary, text_to_int, max_len = 200)),
  dtype = torch_long()
)

# label encoding
labels <- as.integer(bills$status == "Became Law")
num_classes <- length(unique(labels))
bills_binary$label <- labels

# build label data
y <- torch_tensor(labels, dtype = torch_float())

# train test split 
num_rows <- nrow(bills_binary)
idx <- sample(1:num_rows)
train_end <- floor(0.70 * num_rows)
val_end   <- floor(0.85 * num_rows)
train_idx <- idx[1:train_end] # 70% of dataset
val_idx   <- idx[(train_end+1):val_end] # 15% of dataset
test_idx  <- idx[(val_end+1):num_rows] # 15% of dataset

# create data splits
x_train <- X[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]
x_test <- X[test_idx, ]
y_test <- y[test_idx]
x_val <- X[val_idx, ]
y_val <- y[val_idx]

cat("training samples:", length(train_idx), "\n")
cat("testing samples:", length(test_idx), "\n")
cat("validation samples:", length(val_idx))

# model architecture
binaryclass_cnn <- nn_module(
  initialize = function() {
    
    embedding_dim <- 100
    num_filters <- 100
    
    self$embedding <- nn_embedding(
      num_embeddings = vocab_size,
      embedding_dim = embedding_dim,
      padding_idx = stoi[["<pad>"]]
    )
    
    self$conv1 <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = 2
    )
    
    self$conv2 <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = 3
    )
    
    self$conv3 <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = 5
    )
    
    self$dropout <- nn_dropout(p = 0.3) 
    
    self$fc <- nn_linear(
      in_features = num_filters * 3, 
      out_features = 1   
    )
  },
  
  forward = function(x) {
    x <- self$embedding(x)
    x <- x$permute(c(1, 3, 2))
    
    # 'parallel' conv -> ReLU -> max pool for the same input but with different gram sizes
    x1 <- self$conv1(x) # 2 gram conv
    x1 <- torch_relu(x1)
    x1 <- nnf_max_pool1d(x1, kernel_size = x1$size(3))
    
    x2 <- self$conv2(x) # 3 gram conv
    x2 <- torch_relu(x2)
    x2 <- nnf_max_pool1d(x2, kernel_size = x2$size(3))
    
    x3 <- self$conv3(x) # 5 gram conv
    x3 <- torch_relu(x3)
    x3 <- nnf_max_pool1d(x3, kernel_size = x3$size(3))
    
    # combine feat vectors (batch × 300)
    x <- torch_cat(list(x1, x2, x3), dim = 2)

    x <- self$dropout(x) # dropout regularization
    
    x <- torch_flatten(x, start_dim = 2) 
    
    logits <- self$fc(x)
    return(logits)  
  }
)


# initialize
model <- binaryclass_cnn()

# weight each class
class_counts <- table(bills_binary$label)
pos_w <- as.numeric(class_counts["0"] / class_counts["1"])
pos_w <- min(pos_w, 20)
class_weights <- torch_tensor(pos_w, dtype = torch_float())

# define loss function
loss_fn <- nn_bce_with_logits_loss(pos_weight = class_weights)

# ADAM optimization
optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.001) 

cat("\nClass distribution:")
print(class_counts)
```

```{r}
#train
for (epoch in seq_len(epochs)) {
  model$train()
  epoch_loss <- 0
  n <- length(y_train)
  idx <- sample(1:n)
  
  for (i in seq(1, n, by = batch_size)) {
    end <- min(i + batch_size - 1, n)
    batch_idx <- idx[i:end]
    
    inputs <- x_train[batch_idx, ]
    targets <- y_train[batch_idx]$view(c(-1, 1))
    
    # forward pass
    preds <- model(inputs)
    loss <- loss_fn(preds, targets)
    
    # backpropagation
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()
    
    epoch_loss <- epoch_loss + loss$item()
  }
  # validation!
  model$eval()
  with_no_grad({ # temporarily disable gradient calculation to speed up model since there's no weight update in validation anyway
    val_logits <- model(x_val)
    val_labels <- y_val$unsqueeze(2) 
    val_probs <- torch_sigmoid(val_logits)
    val_preds <- (val_probs > 0.3)$to(dtype = torch_float())
    val_acc <- mean(as_array(val_preds) == as_array(val_labels))

  })
  
  # compare model performance and save best model
  if (val_acc > best_val_acc) {
    best_val_acc <- val_acc
    torch_save(model, "binary_model.pt")
  }
  
  val_loss <- loss_fn(val_logits, val_labels)$item()
  
  if (epoch %% 10 == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("epoch %d, train loss: %.4f\n", epoch, epoch_loss))
    cat(sprintf("epoch %d, validation loss: %.4f\n", epoch, val_loss))
    cat("\n")
    }
}

# dimensions
dim(batch_inputs)
batch_inputs$shape
class(model) 
model
```

```{r}
# evaluate
model$eval()

# get logits
logits <- model(x_test)

# convert logits to prob
probs <- torch_sigmoid(logits) 
preds <- (probs > 0.5)$to(dtype = torch_int())

# convert to vectors
true <- as_array(y_test)
pred <- as_array(preds)

# each class accuracy
class_0_idx <- which(true == 0)
class_1_idx <- which(true == 1)

acc_class_0 <- mean(pred[class_0_idx] == true[class_0_idx])
acc_class_1 <- mean(pred[class_1_idx] == true[class_1_idx])

cat("Class Accuracy:\n")
cat(sprintf("Not Became Law (0): %.4f\n", acc_class_0))
cat(sprintf("Became Law (1): %.4f\n", acc_class_1))

# overall accuracy
overall_accuracy <- mean(true == pred)
cat("\nOverall Accuracy:", overall_accuracy, "\n")

# confusion matrix
cat("\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
cm_bin <- table(True = true, Predicted = pred)
print(cm_bin)
```
